title: spec: declare the forward target for trigger-api's inbound hook (`POST /automation/hooks/:flowName/:hookId`) — an optional, transport-neutral member a dispatcher domain can reach (trigger-api segment 1 of ruling A on #22757)
body:
Filing gate ③: a segment the maintainer's ruling directs. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) under ruling A on #22757 (director record `6105447950`, maintainer 「同意」), which directs triage to split the trigger-api member into the #22438 segment shapes (#22575–#22578). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope (the #22575 convention)

- Declare one optional, transport-neutral member that accepts an inbound hook delivery: the flow name, the hook id, the **raw** body bytes and the headers. Its result is the trigger's own answer (`202` accepted, or its typed refusal).
- It goes on the service contract this segment chooses. trigger-api owns no service slot today, as stage 1 of #22564 measured.
- ⛔ The member does not move the signature check out of the trigger. The verifier stays the boundary (condition 2).
- `Clause-②: yes`, since it is a new optional member.
- ⛔ No runtime, core or plugin code here.

## Done when

The member and its docblock are on `main`, with a type-level pin, and segments 2 and 3 can name it.

`domain:spec` · p2 · `security` (it is on the boundary's path).
